Notes and Sources

Quick Start

Each line is one country’s path from 1990 to 2025. Dots mark every five years and the big dot is the year on the slider; use Play to animate it.

Choose a preset to start: Development path (wealth, year and emissions per person), Totals over time, Size vs efficiency or the Kaya plane. To pick your own variable for each axis, use Display options in the menu, top right.

In 3D, drag to rotate, scroll (or pinch) to zoom and right-drag to pan. Reset view and Auto-rotate are in Display options, as are optional shadows that project each path onto the floor and back walls.

The View dropdown also offers flat 2D views, each pairing two of the three axes.

Hover over a line or dot to see its details (or tap on a touch screen). Choose countries from the list, or use the Top 10, G7 and BRICS shortcuts.

This chart is experimental.

Sources

Emissions: EDGAR/JRC based on IEA (2025), EDGAR 2026 GHG (all gases, CO2eq, excl. LULUCF).

GDP (PPP) and population as used in the Emissions Explorer.

Built with Apache ECharts and ECharts GL.

Your browser doesn't support WebGL, which this 3D chart needs.
